items.statement: The investigation preserves and evaluates the six uniquely labeled Co/g-C3N4 states and reports convergence/spin validation for them.
items.expected: All six labels are retained with per-state computational evidence or an explicit bounded failure.

items.statement: The submitted thermodynamic comparison uses Gibbs free-energy differences with the proton/electron reference and documents validation of the thermochemical procedure.
items.expected: Profiles and reference convention are stated and validation is reported.

items.statement: The HSE-L2a OER product comparison gives DeltaDeltaG_OER = PDS(O2)-PDS(H2O2) = 0.35 eV.
The ORR comparison gives G(*+H2O2)-G(*OOH) = -0.35 eV and therefore thermodynamically allows H2O2 formation.
